name: WireView Pro II
author: Luca Nerlich
description: Live GPU power draw from the Thermal Grizzly WireView Pro II, read from the WireView2 app over DBus. The app's own tray icon is rejected by the shell because it violates the SNI spec, so this widget takes its place.

barWidget.description: Shows the live power draw measured by the WireView Pro II device.

schema.label: Hide when off
schema.description: Hide the widget entirely when the WireView app is not running.
